title: Sri Lanka closely monitors Iranian-flagged vessels near EEZ
byline: The Sri Lankan Government is closely monitoring several Iranian-flagged vessels anchored off the country’s coast near the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ), while authorities have clarified that the ships remain outside Sri Lanka’s territorial waters and are therefore not subject to intervention under the country’s jurisdiction.

title: Prime Minister departs for Bhutan
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya departed Sri Lanka today for an official visit to Bhutan, where she is scheduled to participate in the Global Conscious Food Systems Summit.

title: Iran attacks US bases in Jordan after US strikes Larak Island
byline: Iran says it launched missiles at two US bases in Jordan following a US attack on Larak Island in southern Iran earlier on Sunday.

title: Maithripala Sirisena honoured as ‘President of the Happiest Era’
byline: Former President Maithripala Sirisena has been honoured with the title ‘President of the Happiest Era’ at a special international awards ceremony held at Temple Trees in Colombo.

title: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island in first known attack in weeks
byline: US forces have struck two Iranian launchers on Iran’s Larak island, a US official said, marking the first known American strikes on Iran since late July.

title: Four missing after drowning at Pamunugama beach
byline: A woman and three children have gone missing after drowning while bathing in the sea at Epamulla beach in Pamunugama today (31).

title: Ravi Karunanayake appears before bribery commission
byline: Parliamentarian Ravi Karunanayake appeared before the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) today (31) to provide a statement in connection with an ongoing investigation.

title: Ravi Karunanayake arrested after CIABOC questioning
byline: Former Minister Ravi Karunanayake was arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) following questioning over an ongoing investigation.

title: NPP Local Government member resigns after allegedly trespassing into private home and causing damage in Jaffna
byline: Chandrakumar Ganesaruban, a member of the National People’s Power (NPP) of the Vadamarachchi South-West Pradeshiya Sabha in Jaffna, who was arrested on allegations of unlawfully entering a private residence and carrying out an assault, has resigned from his position as a Local Government Council member.

title: Court of Appeal invalidates IRD classification of National Cricketers as SLC employees for Tax Purpose
byline: The Court of Appeal today issued a writ order invalidating the Inland Revenue Department’s (IRD) classification of Sri Lanka’s national cricketers as employees of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC), for tax purposes with retrospective effect.

title: One dead and around 15 missing as flash flood strikes Grand Canyon National Park
byline: One person died and about 15 people remain missing or unaccounted for after a major flash flood at the Grand Canyon forced evacuations, pushed large boulders into the Colorado River and knocked out the sole water pipeline that serves tourists and residents, the National Park Service said Sunday.

title: Over Rs. 408 million earned from expressway traffic in one week
byline: The Road Development Authority (RDA) has generated more than Rs. 408 million in revenue from vehicles using Sri Lanka’s expressway network during the past week.

title: Atlas Angel II brings US, Sri Lankan forces together
byline: The United States and Sri Lanka have commenced Atlas Angel II, a joint military exercise aimed at strengthening cooperation and preparedness for humanitarian assistance and disaster response.

title: Less than half of Ditwah relief allocation utilised
byline: Of the Rs. 500 billion allocated for relief and rehabilitation work in the aftermath of Cyclone Ditwah last December, less than half had been spent during the first half of this year, the Daily Mirror has learnt.

title: Illicit drug shortage sparks surge in rehabilitation demand
byline: A shortage in the availability of illicit drugs has raised concerns among authorities as more drug users seek treatment and rehabilitation, while experts warn that substance abuse continues to contribute to a significant number of deaths in Sri Lanka each day.

title: Hakgala to get plant conservation centre, laboratory and new eco-tourism zone
byline: Plans are underway to establish a plant conservation centre, basic research laboratory and a new eco-tourism zone at Hakgala Botanical Garden, as part of a programme aimed at promoting tourism while protecting the area’s unique montane biodiversity.

title: Iran’s army says it attacked UAE’s Al Minhad Air Base with drones, state TV reports
byline: Iran’s army said it ‌attacked the United Arab Emirates’ Al Minhad Air Base ​with drones early on ​Monday, Iranian state TV ⁠reported, citing a statement ​from the army.

title: Government in discussion with importers on prices of goods
byline: Amid rising prices of several goods, the government has held discussions with importers on measures to address increasing import costs linked to various factors, including the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

title: No special trains for today’s return rush: Station Masters
byline: Long-weekend commuters warned to make alternative travel arrangementsThe Railway Station Master’s Union has raised concerns over the railway’s inability to operate special train services today (Monday (31)) to accommodate the large number of passengers expected to return to Colombo and other urban centres after the long weekend.

title: Nepal on high alert for fresh flooding after river levels rise as death toll passes 900
byline: Residents in flood-affected districts in Nepal were warned to remain on high alert for possible fresh flooding as rescuers scrambled to clear a major highway connecting Kathmandu to one of the areas worst hit by Wednesday’s catastrophic floods.

title: How global diesel price should be reflected? Decision today
byline: In the wake of rising diesel prices in the global market, the Finance Ministry and the Energy Ministry will decide today how the increase should be reflected in next month’s fuel-price revision, an official said.

title: Joint Opposition Fears Government May Try to Postpone Elections
byline: The Joint Opposition, at its seminar in the Galle District, raised concerns about whether the government was planning to postpone the presidential and general elections after the completion of their five-year terms.

title: Crime bosses hit where it hurts: Rs. 6B assets frozen
byline: Sri Lanka Police have frozen assets worth more than Rs. 6 billion linked to organized crime networks, drug trafficking and financial fraud, following 113 investigations, according to the police.

title: Sri Lanka ranks third globally for most public holidays
byline: Sri Lanka has the third-highest number of public holidays of any country in the world, according to a new analysis from the Pew Research Center, behind only Myanmar and Bangladesh.

title: Model Chulpadmendra Kumarapathirana dies
byline: Well-known model and catwalk and pageant trainer Chulpadmendra Kumarapathirana, popularly known as ‘Chula’ has passed away at the age of 46.

title: Google Maps now show ’Lake America’ in US, not ’Lake Ontario’
byline: Google Maps has changed the name of ’’Lake Ontario’’ to ’’Lake America’’ for U.S. users to reflect President Donald Trump’s executive order renaming the lake, according to a Google statement.

title: Suspected ‘ICE’ consignment discovered at Colombo Port
byline: A consignment of drugs suspected to be “ICE” has been discovered inside a container at the Colombo Port, police said.

title: Five-judge bench to hear 22nd Amendment petitions tomorrow
byline: Chief Justice Preethi Padman Surasena has nominated a five-judge bench to hear the Special Determination petitions filed challenging the proposed 22nd Amendment to the Constitution, which seeks to extend the retirement age of superior court judges.

title: Sri Lanka faces heightened Maha season risks from El Niño, high costs
byline: Sri Lanka is facing an elevated risk of disruption to food production during the upcoming Maha cultivation season due to the combined effects of strengthening El Niño conditions, rising input costs and the possibility of heavy rainfall, according to a new United Nations report.

title: 2027 firearm licence renewals open tomorrow
byline: The Ministry of Defence said that the renewal of firearm licences for 2027 will begin tomorrow (September 1).

title: Bread price to increase by Rs. 10
byline: The price of a 450-gram loaf of bread will increase by Rs. 10 from midnight today (August 31), the All Ceylon Bakery Owners’ Association said.

title: Sri Lanka Customs exceeds revenue target ahead of month-end
byline: Sri Lanka Customs has exceeded its revenue target for August, achieving the target before the end of the month, according to Customs authorities.

title: Oil rises as US, Iran resume military attacks
byline: Oil prices were trading nearly 2% higher on Monday after the U.S. attacked ‌an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz and drew retaliation from Tehran, as their conflict extended into its sixth month.

title: Horton Plains to introduce daily visitor limits and online booking
byline: Authorities are planning to introduce daily visitor limits and an online advance booking system at Horton Plains National Park as part of measures to reduce environmental pressure on the sensitive ecosystem.

title: ’A giant leap forward’: Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
byline: Nasa’s powerful next-generation telescope has blasted off into space from its launchpad in Florida, with a mission to explore dark energy, black holes and other mysteries of the Universe.

title: Electric shuttle service proposed to protect Horton Plains environment
byline: Authorities have proposed introducing an Electric Vehicle (EV) shuttle service inside Horton Plains National Park to reduce vehicle emissions, carbon footprints and noise pollution.

title: President calls for greater transparency, investment to develop Sri Lanka’s mineral industry
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake chaired a discussion at the Presidential Secretariat this afternoon on developing Sri Lanka’s mineral industry in line with the export-oriented National Mineral Policy 2026.

title: India must uphold water-sharing treaty with Pakistan, international court says
byline: India must uphold a water-sharing treaty with Pakistan it suspended amid bilateral tensions ​and must limit work on an hydroelectric plant it is building in the ‌Kashmir region, the Permanent Court of Arbitration in the Hague said on Monday.

title: CSE opens the week higher as late buying lifts both indices
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange began the week on a positive note on Monday, 31 August 2026, with both benchmark indices closing marginally higher despite some intraday selling pressure.

title: Six-member committee appointed to study intermediate cadre for medical officers
byline: Health and Mass Media Minister has instructed Ministry Secretary Dr. Anil Jasinghe to appoint a six-member expert committee to study the establishment of an intermediate cadre for medical officers and submit recommendations within one month.

title: As governor sees stability people waiting for Godot?
byline: Stability Is Real. Recovery Is Not Complete. The Next Battle Is Investment, Exports, Jobs and Prosperity.

title: Former Minister Ravi Karunanayake released on bail
byline: Former Finance Minister Ravi Karunanayake, who was arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption over allegations that three employees recruited for a special project of the National Lotteries Board were deployed for his political activities, causing a loss to the Government, was today ordered to be released on bail by Colombo Additional Magistrate Liyan Warushavithana.

title: Two Pakistanis among three arrested over 463 kg ’Ice’ haul
byline: Three more suspects, including two Pakistani nationals, have been arrested in connection with smuggling a massive stock of ’Ice’ (crystal methamphetamine) hidden inside a container.

title: Lionel Messi retires from international football
byline: Argentina great Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football, saying it was a decision that ’’hurt’’ him but ’’the time has come’’.
